title: Ukraine: Six-day localized ceasefire in Oleshky comes to end
summary: A US-brokered ceasefire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region ended on Sunday night with no violations reported. But Russian drones and missiles hit other regions in Ukraine.
byline: Karl Sexton, Richard Connor, Darko Janjevic

image.caption: Ukrainians return to safety after having lived under Russian occupation for four yearsImage: Valentyn Ogirenko/REUTERS

blocks.text: Hundreds of people returned to safety in Ukraine after a localized ceasefire paused fighting between Russia and Ukraine in the front-line town of Oleshky.
Residents in the city lived under Russian occupation for four years, and the situation there worsened this year.
A temporary truce brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump allowed for people to leave the besieged city.
They traveled on a bus through Russia and Belarus to enter Ukrainian territory.
